item.name: 02 Duplicate RideCompleted message
item.description: Development-only at-least-once delivery test. Run 02 Create settlement observer first to initialize collectionVariables; then send each request individually or run the folder. Requires a running PaymentService and RabbitMQ Management credentials in the selected local Postman environment.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('rabbitmq_user') || !pm.variables.get('rabbitmq_password')) throw new Error('Set rabbitmq_user and rabbitmq_password in a local Postman environment.');

request.description: Collection Runner repeats this request once automatically. When sending requests individually, click Send twice; collectionVariables keep the EventId and payload unchanged.

exec: const message = { eventId: pm.collectionVariables.get('duplicate_event_id'), tripId: pm.collectionVariables.get('duplicate_trip_id'), riderId: 'pm-duplicate-rider-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('duplicate_run_id'), driverId: 'pm-duplicate-driver-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('duplicate_run_id'), quoteId: pm.collectionVariables.get('duplicate_quote_id'), fareAmount: 85000, fareCurrency: 'VND', paymentMethod: 'Card', mockTokenAlias: 'tok_card_ok', paymentIdempotencyKey: 'trip-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('duplicate_trip_id') + '-payment', occurredAtUtc: pm.collectionVariables.get('duplicate_occurred_at'), correlationId: 'pm-duplicate-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('duplicate_run_id'), causationId: null };

pm.request.body.update({ mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ properties: { delivery_mode: 2, content_type: 'application/vnd.masstransit+json', message_id: message.eventId }, routing_key: '', payload: JSON.stringify({ messageId: message.eventId, messageType: ['urn:message:SwiftRide.Contracts.V1:RideCompletedV1'], message }), payload_encoding: 'string' }) });

request.description: Collection Runner retries at most 30 times; use a 1000 ms delay. For an individual Send, repeat while messages_ready is 0.

pm.expect(settlements, 'one settlement event for this duplicate trip').to.have.lengthOf(1);
